label: heart-s5-c1

analysis.note: The three gates form a serial chain (204 -> 290 -> 1987), each also read out directly into the logit. 'Readout only' removes a gate's direct edge to the output and leaves downstream gates unchanged; 'node with downstream' replaces the node's activation (zero or train mean) and propagates. Linear replacement = the node's ReLU replaced by the least-squares affine fit of its activation on its own inputs, propagated. Removing the ischaemia gate with its downstream effects takes the model to the linear-core level (0.934); the chain adds +0.008 train AUC.

resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. The serial chain 204 -> 290 -> 1987 (each node also read out to the output) was made into three leaves by intercepting the two chain links with identity nodes (identity_290, identity_1987) that become entries of the downstream leaves; the root composes them. Counter-directional signs reported, not explained: restecg:0 (normal ECG) raises the ischaemia score, trestbps enters the risk-raising BP gate negatively (low resting BP opens it), fbs:0 +0.28 directly. The age gate barely matters (readout ablation -0.001 AUC).
tool_bugs: get_input_distribution does not accept sample_fraction (called with max_samples only; all 242 rows used). get_viz_summary requires viz_type (sensitivity used). compute_shap (kernel, all 242 train rows) gives the four unconnected inputs mean |SHAP| about 0.001 instead of exactly 0 (sampling noise). The agent sandbox refused compound shell commands, so tools were called through a small Python subprocess wrapper in scratch (same xn.py).
summary: Mostly logistic regression: 19 direct edges (logit SD 3.14; train AUC 0.934 alone) plus one serial ischaemia chain (logit SD 0.67) to 0.942. An ischaemia gate ReLU(0.25 + 2.59 oldpeak + 0.87 restecg:0 + 1.15 thal:7) opens above an ST-depression threshold set by a normal resting ECG and a reversible defect and adds risk directly; it feeds a gate that passes the score on minus a resting-blood-pressure offset (more risk when BP is low), which in turn switches off a small extra age term. Oldpeak and restecg:0 act only through this chain. Same design as the 10-seed heart-s5 record (generation 37, key 9330), with three hidden nodes instead of six.
